CaregiverPermissionScope.description:
What a caregiver may do for a patient. Least privilege: grant only what is needed.

Every scope is read-only or writes only information labelled as the caregiver's own
(dose confirmations, reminder times, uploads, reported allergies). Deliberately
absent: editing clinical records, changing a doctor's prescription and deleting
medical records. Those can never be granted to a caregiver
(app/modules/access/permissions.py enforces this again at decision time).
CaregiverPermissionScope.title: CaregiverPermissionScope

DependantBasis.description:
Why someone may manage another person's health record (their declaration).

Minors: a parent or legal guardian consents for them (DPDP Act s.9).
Adults: a lawful guardian or attorney, or the person's own agreement to be helped.

Reports (lab and imaging) must be PDF, JPEG or PNG.

patch.description:
Correct a document's details with a reason. The earlier details stay in its
history; the file itself is never replaced.

post.description: Step 2: the file is checked (type, size, active content, malware) before use.

get.description: A 60-second link; every download is audited.

Doses for `days` calendar days from `day` (default: today in the patient's timezone).
Opening the list also creates upcoming dose rows and records long-unanswered doses as
missed; the reminder engine (Phase 10) does the same on a schedule.

schema.title: Response List Medications Api V1 Patients  Patient Id  Medications Get

post.description:
Doctor: record a medicine the patient already takes (e.g. started elsewhere).
New treatment is written as a prescription instead.

A medicine the patient takes that no doctor prescribed here. Always labelled
patient-reported. The same medicine cannot be added twice while in use.

Ask a linked doctor to confirm a change to a prescribed medicine. Nothing changes
until a doctor approves.

Start a prescribed medicine by choosing reminder times. The dose and food relation
come from the prescription, which is not changed.

schema.title: Response Medication History Api V1 Patients  Patient Id  Medications  Medication Id  History Get

put.description:
Reminder times only. A different number of doses a day for a prescribed medicine
needs a clinician (use /schedule); warnings must be acknowledged.

Change dose, times, frequency, days, food relation or dates. Clinically relevant
changes to a prescribed medicine need `advice` (the doctor or pharmacist who advised
it) or a doctor's approval through a change request.

post.description: What confirming this schedule change would need (nothing is changed).

Discontinue. For a prescribed medicine: acknowledge the warning and record who
advised it (doctor or pharmacist) or that it is your own decision. The prescription
is unchanged.

Response List Scans Api V1 Patients  Patient Id  Prescription Scans Get

post.description:
Start reading an uploaded prescription photo. `mode=manual` opens the same review
screen empty, to type it in next to the photo (no AI involved).

Save the reviewed prescription. It is labelled patient-verified (or doctor-verified),
and its medicines wait for the patient to confirm reminder times.
Discard the reading (for example, the wrong photo). Nothing is saved to the record.

get.description: All versions, newest first. Superseded versions carry `superseded_by_id`.

schema.title: Response List Prescriptions Api V1 Patients  Patient Id  Prescriptions Get

get.description:
The prescription as a document: prescriber and patient details, items as written,
and every version of it (for the history view).

put.description: Edit a draft. Issued prescriptions are immutable: use /revisions to correct one.

post.description:
Cancel an issued prescription (kept as history; its medicines stop), or discard an
unissued draft.

Issue (freeze) a draft. Its medicines appear on the patient's list as awaiting the
patient's confirmation; no reminder starts until they confirm the schedule. Issuing a
correction supersedes the previous version and stops the medicines it started.

get.description: Download the prescription as PDF. Non-current versions are clearly marked.

post.description:
Correct an issued prescription. Creates a new draft version (the issued one is not
touched); issuing that draft supersedes the previous version.

Potential issues with a (draft) prescription against current medicines, allergies
and conditions, before it is issued. Nothing is stored.

patch.description: Personal details only. Clinical records are never edited through this endpoint.

get.description:
Doses to take now: due, reminded, or back from snooze. Works without a worker (the
app polls this), and alongside Web Push when a worker sends reminders.

Withdraw a report added by mistake. It stays in the record, marked with the reason.

get.description: A 60-second link to the report file; works for a report shared with you.

post.description:
A doctor confirms an uploaded report belongs to this patient and its details match

Share this one report with a doctor on the patient's care team, optionally until
